liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **King Bee** (2 reviews): Pigpen's performance is highlighted as being at his absolute best during this track; A sick King Bee and Lovelight provide a bluesy Pigpen fix for listeners [4][9]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Hard to Handle and King Bee are both rated as excellent performances [8]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): The Cryptical to Other One to Cryptical sequence is surprisingly tight and not sluggish [4]
- **Cosmic Charlie** (1 review): This performance is identified as potentially the single worst of the entire 1969 year [3]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): The Lovelight performance is characterized as epic, contradicting claims of an off night [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Turn On Yout Lovelight**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **gd69-04-18.sbd.gardner.7537.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 97 min; rated 3.29/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Generally sluggish, with Phil's vocals described as flat and the overall sound mediocre; The recording is considered excellent, with the Cryptical-Other One-Cryptical sequence described as phenomenal; Good sound quality for the age, with a little hiss that does not deter listening [3][7][8]
- **gd69-04-18.sbd.miller.88867.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 96 min; rated 3.36/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: The reviewer anticipates the concert will rock, noting almost every show did except for one; Described as a great SBD copy to cherish, almost forty years after the fact; The audience sounds different and like an outdoor venue for the last three songs [5][9][11]

## Around the show

- The show occurred around ninety days before Neil and Buzz walked on the Moon [10]
- Electric power failed during the first song, causing a forty-minute delay and Pigpen swearing [13]
- Friend David O from Lafayette performed the light show for the band [13]
- The band packed their own gear, and the reviewer stood in front of Jerry [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-04-18.sbd.gardner.7537.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Tony G; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: The setlist includes a transition from Cryptical Envelopment to Drums to The Other One [1]
- **gd69-04-18.sbd.miller.88867.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Purdue Univ. Poster 4/69](https://www.dead.net/archives/1969/artwork/purdue-univ-poster-4-69) [16]
- Poster by Antoine Julien There: [Grateful Dead - Indiana Rock History](https://indianarockhistory.com/concert/grateful-dead-7/) [17]
